title: 5 - How do you Name Covalent Compounds (Molecules)?
Digestive System Comparison Structures TABLE + DRAWINGS
description:
Using the table you created, you will draw side by side drawings of the  
digestive system and your structure.  You should COLOR CODE them - in my  
example if I used red for the farm gate, II would also use red for the mouth.  
 I know some structures might be hard to draw but do your best!  It should  
be neat, organized and labeled.  Please SUBMIT HERE as a picture- one copy  
per group - making sure all group memeber's names are included.  This can be  
completed as an electronic or hand drawn copy.

**I have included just the beginning of my drawing to give you an idea of how  
to make the "side by side." 

MAKE SURE TO SUBMIT BOTH YOUR TABLE and DRAWING HERE! You will have about  
5-10 minutes on Thursday to finish. - Link: http://troyschools.schoology.com/assignment/8613630558

title:
Quiz - Ionic vs Covalent Compounds, Lewis dot diagrams and structures, and  
Naming Compounds
description:
Quiz Topics:

  -  Ionic vs. covalent compounds (#3), 

  -  Lewis dot diagrams to form compounds (#4 notes and assignments), 

  -  Naming covalent vs. ionic compounds (#5 notes and assignments).

 

You can use a half piece of paper, front and back.

It must be hand-written.

 

I would suggest looking over:

        * #1 Vocabulary terms 1-8

        * Assignments and discussion questions #3, 4a, 4b, 4c, 5, 6

        * 4n - Compounds, Molecules, and Dot Structure notes

        * 5n - Naming Covalent Compounds Notes
